newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine dam concession to bypass Congress - paper.
newsitem.headline: Argentine dam concession to bypass Congress - paper.

text.p: Argentina's government is planning to tender the concessions for the Yacyreta hydro-electric dam without approval from Congress, daily Clarin reported Thursday.

It quoted a government proposal as saying the privatization of Yacyreta, which is jointly owned by Argentina and Paraguay, is able to go through without legislative approval because the sale will take the form of concessions rather that the actual sale of the dam.

The proposal said "this has nothing to do with the sale of Yacyreta, but with the calling of a tender for concessions. The dam will continue to be the property of the states (of Paraguay and Argentina)," according to Clarin.
The Argentine government is counting on the go-ahead from Paraguay's government.

It was not immediately clear how the government could tender the concessions without Congress' approval considering other privatizations have also been carried out through concessions but have required the Congress' go-ahead.
Clarin said the government's proposal to bypass Congress was likely to meet protests from opposition political parties.
